name: PAD HOTKEYS
description: Reach the display hotkeys from a controller. The engine's digit toggles -- and every mod pipeline that claims one, including the voxel mod's VOXEL, V-GRID, T-SHIFT, V-CURVE, 3D-BTL and WATER ladders -- are keyboard-only, which is useless on a couch. This binds them to the pad buttons the engine leaves free: the two stick clicks (L3/R3) and the X/Y face buttons. Each button's target is an options row, so every player can pick their own. Polls the pad rather than intercepting its events, and honours the split-screen pad assignment so player 2's stick click only changes player 2's screen.
